column1: # Source-owned test evidence for the handshake and listener lifecycle wave.

column8: Truncated common-header vectors return explicit errors without panic; the Go logger/error-code integration and full connection path remain open.

Source-shaped header/body, auth, database, plugin, and connection-attribute vectors execute; AuthHandshake now preserves the raw response and exposes identity-plugin deferral/switch decisions, while authentication verification and session-variable application remain open.

Protocol-41 capability negotiation, explicit SSLRequest/TLS-pending transition, legacy native fallback/rejection, and malformed length paths are covered; transport TLS, auth-switch I/O, and server error-code plumbing remain open.
Connection-attribute truncation/malformed-length behavior is bounded by the 1 MiB parser limit; TiDB metrics/policy and audit hooks remain open.
